en.io: Input: meeting agenda, deck, current operating metrics, known misses, director concerns, and requested decisions. Output: numbers-to-master list, adversarial questions, narrative structure, mock-meeting prompts, director map, pre-meeting checklist, and follow-up actions.
en.boundary: Preparation guidance only; it does not verify metrics unless source data is supplied or manage board governance. Sensitive disclosures and legal obligations require appropriate company counsel and governance processes.
dependencies: Knowledge of director priorities and prior meeting commitments
scenarios: Prepare for a quarterly board meeting.
Rehearse an investor update after a revenue miss.
Build a pre-read and explicit asks for a high-stakes review.

zh.io: 输入：会议议程、演示材料、当前运营指标、已知偏差、董事关注点和待决事项。输出：必须熟记的数字、对抗性问题、叙事结构、模拟会议提示、董事画像、会前清单和会后动作。
zh.boundary: 只提供准备指导；除非提供源数据，否则不核验指标，也不管理董事会治理。敏感披露和法律义务需由公司律师及正式治理流程处理。
dependencies: 来自源系统的当前指标
董事重点及既往承诺信息
scenarios: 在营收未达标后演练投资人更新。
为高风险审查准备预读材料和明确诉求。
